title: XRP 2017–2018: Japanese bank pilots, the escrow, a 500× run to the January 2018 top, and a −90% bust

title: S1 variants tested: a BTC market filter and "let winners run" exits
summary: Paper research across the 13 S1 tests on the first 10 coins (1% risk, 25% cap, 0.3% cost). Baseline S1: avg +16.6%, avg max DD -6.7%, worst DD -11.8%, 36% win rate, about $9.9/mo at $2k. A1 (alts only when BTC > 200-day SMA): +16.2%, no improvement. A2 (BTC 50d > 200d): +14.1%, no improvement. B1 (trail widens to 4x ATR after +3R): +27.1% but worst DD -17.3%. B2 (no trail, exit on close < 50-day SMA): +42.3% but worst DD -79.9%, flagged unacceptable. A1+B1: +26.5%. Gains came from bull-market halves; out of sample (second halves) every variant was within +0.3 pts of baseline, so none clearly beats baseline yet. No playbook change for Seedling until the user approves. Historical paper results are not a forecast. Educational only, not financial advice.
